summary: Metalpha Technology Holding Limited, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer whose American Depositary Shares trade in the US, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that its board approved, on September 28, 2026, an amendment and restatement of its 2024 Share Incentive Plan. The sole substantive change increases the maximum aggregate ordinary shares issuable under the plan from 2,000,000 to 5,000,000 ordinary shares, par value US$0.0001, a 3,000,000-share or 150% increase. The compensation committee recommended the change; all other plan terms are unchanged. This is an equity-compensation matter, not a special situation; watch dilution and S-8 registration overhang.
